_purpose: The complete Git cheatsheet: every command worth knowing, one line each, everywhere Git runs.
_tech: JSON, rendered into cheatsheet.html by build_pages.py; also feeds the printable PDF and cards
_description: Grouped by task. danger true marks commands that rewrite history or can destroy work. Not restricted to GitHub: platform section covers every major host and the no-host workflows.
